quotes.name: Harried Artisan // Phyrexian Skyflayer
quotes.flavor: As strange portals roared open across Theros, Lydus gathered his prototype and fled. He was so close to perfecting his design.

quotes.name: Millikin
quotes.flavor: A machine that dazes and confuses its enemies with bewildering signals.

quotes.name: Tormod's Cryptkeeper
quotes.flavor: It guards not a body, but a secret.

quotes.name: Through the Forest Gate
quotes.flavor:
"Well, here is Mirkwood—the greatest of the forests of the northern world. I hope you like the look of it."
—Gandalf

quotes.name: Stabbing Pain
quotes.flavor:
"You can take the fight out of nearly any creature if you know where its soft spot is."
—Guttor, flesh-warper

quotes.name: Sedge Troll
quotes.flavor: The stench in the hovel was overpowering; something loathsome was cooking. Occasionally something surfaced in the thick paste, but my host would casually push it down before I could make out what it was.

quotes.name: Eternal Witness
quotes.flavor: She remembers all those who would otherwise be forgotten.

quotes.name: Dungeon Delver
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: You're driven not by a lust for gold or baubles, but by the thrill of danger and the excitement of the unknown.

quotes.name: Lavaborn Muse
quotes.flavor:
"Her voice is disaster, painful and final."
—Matoc, lavamancer

quotes.name: Sol Ring
quotes.flavor:
"All creation in a single point, the point of all creation in all."
—Sunstar loop-mantra

quotes.name: Light of Sanction
quotes.flavor: The Legion looks after its own.

quotes.name: Sulfuric Vortex
quotes.flavor: As the life drained out of Kratos, the arms of Hades reached out to claim their prize.

quotes.name: Invisibility
quotes.flavor: Verick held his breath. Breathing wouldn't reveal his position, but it would force him to smell the goblins.

quotes.name: Mortuary
quotes.flavor:
"Think of them not as failures but as works in progress."
—Volrath

quotes.name: Treacherous Greed
quotes.flavor: Loot's easy to divide by one.

quotes.name: Quench
quotes.flavor: "When properly invoked, the plasma globule encloses the offensive spell with a satisfying slurp."

quotes.name: Evra, Halcyon Witness
quotes.flavor:
"Light from the Null Moon took form—a mirage made real, alone in grandeur, isolated in a world that once had been its own."
—*Fall of the Thran*

quotes.name: Terror of the Peaks
quotes.flavor: Kogan likes dragons for their terrible majesty.

quotes.name: Autochthon Wurm
quotes.flavor: The trainer awoke to begin the journey from the wurm's tail to its head. The sun was setting when she arrived.

quotes.name: Scooch
quotes.flavor:
"What? No, that's ridiculous! Of course the rat doesn't work for the park. I've never seen it before in my life!"
—Monoxa, midway manager

quotes.name: Goblin Trenches
quotes.flavor: The ground rose and formed into thousands of tiny warriors. This fight was far from over.

quotes.name: Ambush Party
quotes.flavor:
"Fair fight? I'll take survival over chivalry any day!"
—Tor Wauki, Bandit King

quotes.name: Claire D'Loon, Joy Sculptor
quotes.flavor: She'll sculpt goblins, saprolings, Marit Lage . . . though that one takes a *lot* of balloons.

quotes.name: Trudge Garden
quotes.flavor:
"Sure, trudges smell like soggy death, but the mushrooms on their backs are the tastiest delicacy in Sedgemoor!"
—Gyome, Witherbloom chef

quotes.name: Polukranos Reborn // Polukranos, Engine of Ruin
quotes.flavor: Freed from the Underworld, the World Eater resumed his endless feast with reckless enthusiasm.

quotes.name: Plated Slagwurm
quotes.flavor: Beneath the Tangle, the wurm tunnels stretch . . . wide as a stone's throw, long as forever, deep as you dare.

quotes.name: Winds of Rath
quotes.flavor:
"There shall be a vast shout and then a vaster silence."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

quotes.name: Llanowar Tribe
quotes.flavor: "Llanowar remembers the Ice Age, the Phyrexian Invasion, and the Rift Era. So long as we draw breath, we will ensure such disasters never threaten our world again."

quotes.name: Annoyed Altisaur
quotes.flavor: It pairs a long neck with a short temper.

quotes.name: Ancient Cornucopia
quotes.flavor:
"I reckon that thing's trying to put me out of a job!"
—Bristly Bill, cactusfolk gardener

quotes.name: Promise of Bunrei
quotes.flavor: "I am not afraid to die today nor afraid of what death will bring."

quotes.name: Gideon's Lawkeeper
quotes.flavor: "The essence of a lawful society is swift deterrence."

quotes.name: Disciple of Freyalise // Garden of Freyalise
quotes.flavor: The Juniper Order safeguards secret places that still thrum with traces of Freyalise's life-giving magic.

quotes.name: Dream Harvest
quotes.flavor: Faeries swarm to snoring boggarts like vultures to rotting meat.

quotes.name: Runaway Carriage
quotes.flavor:
"They left in one piece. I can't speak to how they arrived."
—Rupirk, porter at the Rusted Anchor Inn

quotes.name: Llanowar Elves
quotes.flavor: Llanowar covers a million square miles, yet nobody enters the forest without the elves knowing it.

quotes.name: Lightning Greaves
quotes.flavor: After lightning struck the cliffs, the ore became iron, the iron became steel, and the steel became greaves. The lightning never left.

quotes.name: Sungrass Prairie
quotes.flavor: On Otaria, peace and harmony are rare. Places that provide both are cherished.

quotes.name: Mass Hysteria
quotes.flavor: The sooner you see the whites of their eyes, the sooner you'll spill the red of their blood.

quotes.name: Self-Assembler
quotes.flavor: It sees itself in all of its creations.

quotes.name: Dissipate
quotes.flavor:
"If you weren't born with it, you don't need it."
—Grahilah, former trader of Amiqat

quotes.name: Bog Wraith
quotes.flavor: She died in this swamp, and so will you.

quotes.name: Warbeast of Gorgoroth
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: Drums rolled, fires leaped, and great engines drawn by beasts crawled across the field.

quotes.name: Mahamoti Djinn
quotes.flavor: Of royal blood among the spirits of the air, the Mahamoti djinn rides on the wings of the winds. As dangerous in the gambling hall as he is in battle, he is a master of trickery and misdirection.

quotes.name: Precinct Captain
quotes.flavor: "In troubled times, we all need someone to watch our back."

quotes.name: Worldsoul's Rage
quotes.flavor: "Hoarding supplies, profiting from death and destruction, colluding with the invaders—every one of them betrayed Ravnica in its time of greatest need. They all deserved to die. And I'm not done yet!"

quotes.name: Forest
quotes.flavor: Before the elf queen will aid you, you must find a way to cure the strange rot afflicting the roots of the ancient trees.

quotes.name: Lotus Cobra
quotes.flavor: Its hood blossoms as a warning: receive your gift, but stray no closer.

quotes.name: Forgotten Ancient
quotes.flavor: Its blood is life. Its body is growth.

quotes.name: Rewind
quotes.flavor: "Let's go over this one more time. . . ."

quotes.name: Hero of the Pride
quotes.flavor: Leonin fight for neither god nor polis; their loyalty is to their pride.

quotes.name: Final Flare
quotes.flavor: Those who fought without honor in life are taken to Agonas and doomed to fight forever in its arenas.

quotes.name: Dwarven Catapult
quotes.flavor:
"Often greatly outnumbered in battle, dwarves relied on catapults as one means of damaging a large army."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. IV*

quotes.name: Urborg Syphon-Mage
quotes.flavor: "I have become a gourmet of sorts. Each soul has its own distinctive flavor. The art is in inviting the right company to the feast."

quotes.name: Howling Golem
quotes.flavor: It wails of buried riches and the souls lost seeking them.

quotes.name: Grimdancer
quotes.flavor: Most monsters are more frightening when they skitter unseen in the dark. Most.

quotes.name: Dimir Guildgate
quotes.flavor: Enter and become a mastermind of spies, lies, and deception.

quotes.name: Witch-king, Bringer of Ruin
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: "No living man may hinder me!"

quotes.name: Jace, Vryn's Prodigy // Jace, Telepath Unbound
quotes.flavor: "People's thoughts just come to me. Sometimes I don't know if it's them or me thinking."

quotes.name: Compulsive Research
quotes.flavor: "Four parts molten bronze, yes . . . one part frozen mercury, yes, yes . . . but then what?"

quotes.name: Pressure Point
quotes.flavor: By studying dragon anatomy, Jeskai monks have learned how to locate clusters of nerves that will incapacitate even the mightiest dragons.

quotes.name: Latch Seeker
quotes.flavor: It seeks a tomb that will hold it, a coffin that will give it rest.

quotes.name: Delney, Streetwise Lookout
quotes.flavor: "It's not a matter of what I know. It's a matter of making it worth my while to tell you."

quotes.name: Mystical Tutor
quotes.flavor: Wisdom is a well that never runs dry. It offers the most to those with the deepest thirst for knowledge.

quotes.name: Anurid Scavenger
quotes.flavor: Krosa's topmost bottom feeder.

quotes.name: Sanguine Bond
quotes.flavor:
"Blood is constant. Every drop I drink, someone must bleed."
—Vradeen, vampire nocturnus

quotes.name: Ornamental Courage
quotes.flavor: Inspired by the thorns and brambles of the untamed wilds, elvish armor is both beautiful and formidable.

quotes.name: Lightning Mare
quotes.flavor: When it passes, storm clouds bolt across the land.

quotes.name: Esper Panorama
quotes.flavor: Esper is an expansive canvas painted by precise, controlling hands.

quotes.name: Mortivore
quotes.flavor: The light sigh of its breath whistles through its bones.

quotes.name: Zombie Infestation
quotes.flavor: The nomads' funeral pyres are more practical than ceremonial.

quotes.name: Terminate
quotes.flavor:
"I've seen death before. My mother succumbing to illness, my comrades bleeding on the battlefield . . . But I'd never seen anything as dreadful as that."
—Taani, berserker of Etlan

quotes.name: Guardian Project
quotes.flavor:
"They will give me the army I need to bring peace to the entire wasteland."
—The Master

quotes.name: Garland, Knight of Cornelia // Chaos, the Endless
quotes.flavor: "Even as you die again and again, I shall return!"

quotes.name: Frazzled Editor
quotes.flavor: The pen is mightier than the sword.

quotes.name: Ancestor's Prophet
quotes.flavor: "We have faced horrors of war and terrors beyond imagining. We will overcome the uncertainties of this new life."

quotes.name: Skywing Aven
quotes.flavor: "I am as the wind that bears me: harsh yet gentle, fleeting yet ever-present. Together we fly beyond imagination."

quotes.name: Hedron Archive
quotes.flavor:
"You've begun to understand the hedrons' true purpose," said Ugin. "The Eldrazi can be imprisoned."
"And how did that work out last time?" asked Jace.

quotes.name: Millstone
quotes.flavor: Minds, like mountains, are never so grand and mighty that they can't be reduced to dust.

quotes.name: Foreboding Statue // Forsaken Thresher
quotes.flavor: As the sand eroded, a faint sound could be heard whirling under the ground.

quotes.name: Stitcher's Supplier
quotes.flavor: No part goes to waste.

quotes.name: Ensnaring Bridge
quotes.flavor:
"Why build a bridge that needs to be guarded?"
—Elvish champion

quotes.name: Flayed One
quotes.flavor: Those suspected of carrying the flayer curse are summarily banished, lest the corruption spread to other Necrons.

quotes.name: Serra Redeemer
quotes.flavor: "Heroism is neither a strong arm nor a divine destiny. It is the choice to stand unbowed against impossible odds."

quotes.name: Aziza, Mage Tower Captain
quotes.flavor: "Good play, team! Now let's run it again until it's perfect!"

quotes.name: Abyssal Harvester
quotes.flavor: Final moments stricken by terror make the corpses into potent magical fuel.

quotes.name: Ignoble Hierarch
quotes.flavor: He protects the fetid bog from light, life, and the hideous sound of laughter.

quotes.name: Annie Joins Up
quotes.flavor: One last job, then she could retire in peace.

quotes.name: Shamanic Revelation
quotes.flavor: First, whispers of ancient days. Then, visions of things to come.

quotes.name: Embereth Shieldbreaker // Battle Display
quotes.flavor: "Courage is the only shield I need."

quotes.name: Worst Fears
quotes.flavor: Elspeth feared that her trespass into Nyx would not go unanswered.

quotes.name: Lifecrafter's Bestiary
quotes.flavor:
"Inspiration is found by looking outward."
—Oviya Pashiri, sage lifecrafter

quotes.name: Dawntreader Elk
quotes.flavor: Silent as winter snow, it seeks wild places unspoiled by the walking dead.

quotes.name: Stolen Uniform
quotes.flavor: "It's a little tight, but the price was right!"

quotes.name: Sudden Insight
quotes.flavor: He sought to peer beneath the surface of the moon. Instead, he peeled back the skin of reality itself.

quotes.name: Mystic Monastery
quotes.flavor:
"Hey, come see me at the Top of the World when you get a chance. I've got something for you. And, I pinky-swear I won't kill you."
—Rose, robotic raider

quotes.name: Archangel of Thune
quotes.flavor: Even the wicked have nightmares.

quotes.name: Violent Outburst
quotes.flavor: Yarn unspooled, squeaky toys de-squeaked, upholstery torn to shreds—it was carnage.

quotes.name: Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite
quotes.flavor: "Rejoice, blessed evangels! The glorious light of *compleation* is nigh. Soon, we shall awaken the Multiverse from its slumber."

quotes.name: Rukh Egg
quotes.flavor: Called "stonefeathers" by many lowlanders, rukhs are thought to descend from a phoenix that sacrificed its flame for a body of stone.

quotes.name: Spore Frog
quotes.flavor: Gromp spores can be distilled into a variety of powerful chemical agents, or added to tea for a disastrous afternoon in the city.

quotes.name: Vernadi Shieldmate
quotes.flavor: "Selesnya's soil is sacred, and you're about to meet it with your face."

quotes.name: Beast Whisperer
quotes.flavor: "The tiniest mouse speaks louder to me than all the festival crowds on Tin Street."

quotes.name: Force of Negation
quotes.flavor: Not even the most scathing critics can break her concentration.

quotes.name: Ferocious Pup
quotes.flavor: The strongest pack has the fiercest pups.

quotes.name: Zephid
quotes.flavor: Once you've seen one, you'll understand why spells won't go near them.

quotes.name: Henge Guardian
quotes.flavor: Like so many Thran relics, the wurm engine kept operating long after its creators were gone.

quotes.name: Possession Engine
quotes.flavor: Take it for a spin. That's not a request.

quotes.name: Benalish Cavalry
quotes.flavor: "My people swore to protect Benalia to the end. It is battered, but yet stands, as do we."

quotes.name: Watercourser
quotes.flavor:
"Beware an eddy where there should be none or a stretch that flows too fast or too slow."
—Old Fishbones, Martyne river guide

quotes.name: Rampant Growth
quotes.flavor: Nature grows solutions to her problems.

quotes.name: Mist-Cloaked Herald
quotes.flavor: The reach of Atlantis travels far beyond the waves.

quotes.name: Ascend from Avernus
quotes.flavor: Smoke clogged the streets and rubble littered the ground, but sunlight shining on the long-lost towers of Elturel was still a beautiful sight.

quotes.name: Judith, the Scourge Diva
quotes.flavor: At the end of the show, she stands alone on a stage brilliant with blood.

quotes.name: Legion's Judgment
quotes.flavor: "My lance was once wielded by Venerable Tarrian. In his name and by his might, I cast you down!"

quotes.name: Diamond Weapon
quotes.flavor: A tutelary creature said only to appear when the planet is in grave danger.

quotes.name: Shock
quotes.flavor: The tools of invention became the weapons of revolution.

quotes.name: Gutter Skulker // Gutter Shortcut
quotes.flavor: Geists have a knack for showing up wherever they're least expected.

quotes.name: Foul Orchard
quotes.flavor: On Amonkhet, death is an ever-present part of life.

quotes.name: Thran Dynamo
quotes.flavor: Urza's metathran children were conceived, birthed, and nurtured by an integrated system of machines.

quotes.name: Distracting Geist // Clever Distraction
quotes.flavor: "Me neither."

quotes.name: Rally to Battle
quotes.flavor: The guildmasters loom large in the political sphere, but in the end, the rulers of Ravnica are its people.

quotes.name: Raven's Crime
quotes.flavor: It plucks away memories like choice bits of carrion.

quotes.name: Dragonskull Summit
quotes.flavor:
"You mean someone made all this? Dragons?"
—Sabalom Glitz

quotes.name: Helping Hand
quotes.flavor:
"Kindness is a war of its own, and one that must never be lost."
—*The War-Healer's Treatise*

quotes.name: Covetous Dragon
quotes.flavor: Gatha survived as long as he did by giving all Keld's predators exactly what they wanted.

quotes.name: Thought Vessel
quotes.flavor:
"Oh, it's only an old relic. Like me."
—Professor Yana

quotes.name: Inferno
quotes.flavor:
"Some have said there is no subtlety to destruction. You know what? They're dead."
—Wandering mage

quotes.name: Deathbloom Thallid
quotes.flavor:
"Nature is not always gentle or kind, but all life begets life."
—Marwyn of Llanowar

quotes.name: Shatter
quotes.flavor:
"Let the past be the past. Do not call up that which you cannot put down. Destroy that which destroyed us, so long ago."
—Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi Heretic

quotes.name: Durkwood Boars
quotes.flavor:
"And the unclean spirits went out, and entered the swine: and the herd ran violently . . . ."
—*The Bible*, Mark 5:13

quotes.name: Pyrokinesis
quotes.flavor:
"Anybody want some . . . toast?"
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

quotes.name: The Surgical Bay
quotes.flavor: In Jin-Gitaxias's domain, strange and terrible experiments iterate toward perfection, unbound by ethics.

quotes.name: Kruin Outlaw // Terror of Kruin Pass
quotes.flavor: "Hold tight. I've got a surprise for them."

quotes.name: Evolving Wilds
quotes.flavor:
"Stensia blazes with new heat. Nephalia's tides are chaotic. And everywhere, this unnatural frost. The land is sending a warning."
—Katilda, Dawnhart Prime

quotes.name: Akal Pakal, First Among Equals
quotes.flavor: "These lost children of Aclazotz are misguided, but perhaps there can be reconciliation of our ideals without war."

quotes.name: Myr Landshaper
quotes.flavor: One thing the myr can't do is enjoy the scenery.

quotes.name: Snakeskin Veil
quotes.flavor:
"Never reject the kindness of a serpent. It will not be offered twice."
—Druidic manuscript fragment

quotes.name: Serendib Efreet
quotes.flavor: Summoners of efreeti remember only the power of command, never the sting of regret.

quotes.name: Gaea's Will
quotes.flavor: With every end, a new beginning.

quotes.name: Lavinia, Azorius Renegade
quotes.flavor: "I told Jace that Ravnica would fall apart if he didn't take his responsibilities seriously. I didn't want to be right."

quotes.name: Sphinx of the Steel Wind
quotes.flavor: No one has properly answered her favorite riddle: "Why should I spare your life?"

quotes.name: Omniscience
quotes.flavor:
"They are led by Talion, the Kindly Lord,
First and Greatest of the High Fae,
Sovereign of the Court, the Liege of Laughter,
Finder of the First Yew, and the One True Lord of Eldraine."
—*On the High Fae*

quotes.name: Fecundity
quotes.flavor: Life is eternal. A lifetime is ephemeral.

quotes.name: Azorius Signet
quotes.flavor: The maze-like design embodies the core of Azorius law—strict structure designed to test wills and stall change.

quotes.name: Traumatize
quotes.flavor:
"The educated mind is heavy with lore and knowledge. It's also the most likely to collapse under its own weight."
—Ambassador Laquatus

quotes.name: Pitfall Trap
quotes.flavor: Each spike is poisoned—the trapmaker's idea of mercy.

quotes.name: Hengegate Pathway // Mistgate Pathway
quotes.flavor:
"I've never seen mist so unnaturally thick as this—where does the sea end and the sky begin?"
—Ekken, Omenseeker navigator

quotes.name: I Am Never Alone
quotes.flavor: "This is but a pale shadow of my true form. Cower before it, and despair."

quotes.name: Repulse
quotes.flavor: "You aren't invited."

quotes.name: Lightstall Inquisitor
quotes.flavor: Born of dead stars, the Astelli may fight for light, but they know the void as their womb.

quotes.name: Éowyn, Fearless Knight
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: "Am I not of the House of Eorl? I have waited on faltering feet long enough."

quotes.name: Iona's Judgment
quotes.flavor: Beneath the gaze of angels, only the righteous may stand without fear.

quotes.name: Phyrexian Hulk
quotes.flavor:
It doesn't think. It doesn't feel.
It doesn't laugh or cry.
All it does from dusk till dawn
Is make the soldiers die.
—Onean children's rhyme

quotes.name: Lightwalker
quotes.flavor:
"The greatest gift Dromoka gives is the ability to fly without wings."
—Urdnan, Dromoka warrior

quotes.name: Noctis, Prince of Lucis
quotes.flavor: Many sacrificed all for the King; so must the King sacrifice himself for all.

quotes.name: Zodiac Tiger
quotes.flavor: ". . . Three kings no more—Chenliu, Guiming, Anle. / The fiefs and posts must now be filled anew. . . ."

quotes.name: Bloodtracker
quotes.flavor: "Flee all you like. The further you run the more firmly I feel your heartbeat."

quotes.name: Noxious Grasp
quotes.flavor:
"The bog doesn't give a stinking bubble about your title, wealth, or piety. It's just hungry."
—Byaras, backwoods guide

quotes.name: Black Dragon
quotes.flavor: Black dragons revel in the collapse of humanoid kingdoms.

quotes.name: Three Visits
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: Those who love the woods only wish to spread its majesty.

quotes.name: Greenwheel Liberator
quotes.flavor: "I will not rest until every vestige of the Consulate—every banner, flag, and standard—has fallen."

quotes.name: Riveteers Overlook
quotes.flavor: Along the outer girders, in gold filigree, are inscribed the names of all those who fell to their deaths during construction.

quotes.name: Benalish Knight
quotes.flavor:
"We called them 'armored lightning.'"
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

quotes.name: Pygmy Pyrosaur
quotes.flavor:
Do not judge a lizard by its size.
—Ghitu proverb

quotes.name: Frenzied Goblin
quotes.flavor: The upside to not thinking about the consequences is that you'll always surprise those who do.

quotes.name: Flubs, the Fool
quotes.flavor: He knows exactly where he's going and exactly how he isn't getting there.

quotes.name: Sewer Rats
quotes.flavor:
You lie down with rats, and the rats run away.
—Suq'Ata insult

quotes.name: Lotus Guardian
quotes.flavor: Lotus fields are too valuable to leave undefended.

quotes.name: Quicksmith Rebel
quotes.flavor: "Let's add just a bit more stopping power."

quotes.name: Martial Coup
quotes.flavor:
"Namor thinks himself safe beneath the waves. Show him how wrong he is."
—T'Challa, the Black Panther

quotes.name: Secure the Wastes
quotes.flavor:
"The Shifting Wastes provide our clan eternal protection. It is our duty to return the favor."
—Kadri, Dromoka warrior

quotes.name: South Pole Voyager
quotes.flavor: "The winds can be brutal, so be brave."

quotes.name: Wrap in Flames
quotes.flavor:
"Our pyromancer's flames may not have killed them, but they bought us the time we needed."
—*The War Diaries*

quotes.name: Evolving Wilds
quotes.flavor: Every world is an organism, able to grow new lands. Some just do it faster than others.

quotes.name: Angel of Finality
quotes.flavor: "Better the dead depart utterly than be enslaved."

quotes.name: Pegasus Courser
quotes.flavor: A pegasus chooses its rider, bearing the worthy into the clouds and tossing all others to the ground.

quotes.name: Bojuka Bog
quotes.flavor: There loomed against the westward stars a dark black shape: a great barrow stood there.

quotes.name: Blighted Bat
quotes.flavor: Amonkhet's dual suns don't allow for the darkness of night, so bats are most active under the gloom of the frequent sandstorms.

quotes.name: Spider Manifestation
quotes.flavor: Some spiders feed on *other* spiders.

quotes.name: Cryogen Relic
quotes.flavor: Older than the Eumidian seedships that populated Evendo.

quotes.name: Swords to Plowshares
quotes.flavor: The smallest seed of regret can bloom into redemption.

quotes.name: Etali, Primal Storm
quotes.flavor: He is the roaring hurricane, the earthquake's sundering fury, the embodiment of wild, untamable power.

quotes.name: Nesting Grounds
quotes.flavor: Dappled coats become armored hides. Soft jaws become razor tusks. Nestling play becomes the fight for survival.

quotes.name: Arc Lightning
quotes.flavor: Rainclouds don't last long in Shiv, but that doesn't stop the lightning.

quotes.name: Polymorphist's Jest
quotes.flavor:
"The flies were bothering me."
—Jalira, master polymorphist

quotes.name: Coordinated Maneuver
quotes.flavor:
"We follow the dragonstorms, and we take down any threats that emerge from them!"
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

quotes.name: Cosmogrand Zenith
quotes.flavor: "Perfection lies beyond ego. Only through service can you become complete."

quotes.name: It Came from Planet Glurg
quotes.flavor: A sludge with a grudge.

quotes.name: Brine Elemental
quotes.flavor: Water calls to water, and the world is left exhausted and withered in its wake.

quotes.name: Mowu, Loyal Companion
quotes.flavor: Wherever Yanggu goes, Mowu follows—sometimes at his side, sometimes obscuring him from view entirely.

quotes.name: Pristine Skywise
quotes.flavor: The elite of Ojutai's brood, the skywise see their enemies as puzzles to be solved.

quotes.name: Stalwarts of Osgiliath
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"The Enemy must pay dearly for the crossing of the River."
—Denethor

quotes.name: Bant Panorama
quotes.flavor: Bant's hearts are as pure as its air and as bright as its skies.

quotes.name: Cragcrown Pathway // Timbercrown Pathway
quotes.flavor:
"The greatest danger on the path is a failure of nerve."
—Enwor, Sea Gate Expeditionary House

quotes.name: Plummet
quotes.flavor:
"Still, the pterodon chasing the clouds from its skies must bow to the great forest below."
—Mahuiz, Sun Empire archer

quotes.name: Dwell on the Past
quotes.flavor:
None can find what hasn't been lost.
—Nantuko teaching

quotes.name: Foreboding Ruins
quotes.flavor: The road appeared lonely and forsaken, running down to empty ruins in the mist. But there was an evil feeling in the air.

quotes.name: Kabira Takedown // Kabira Plateau
quotes.flavor:
"Down below's where things go to die."
—Kreq of Sunder Bay

quotes.name: Unholy Strength
quotes.flavor: "I don't *feel* any different."

quotes.name: Kaervek, the Spiteful
quotes.flavor: "Defy me and I will burn the flesh from your bones. Betray me and I will steal the breath from your lungs."

quotes.name: Rampaging Ceratops
quotes.flavor: Anticipating tight spaces and trivial fauna, the first Dusk Legion expeditions were small, mobile, and lightly armored. Hundreds of casualties later, they started sending plate-clad platoons.

quotes.name: Hair-Strung Koto
quotes.flavor:
"The Kami War drove many members of Konda's court insane. As their spiritual world turned against them, so too did their minds turn from reality."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

quotes.name: Celestial Enforcer
quotes.flavor: "I look to the heavens for hope, but you will kneel."

quotes.name: Psychic Strike
quotes.flavor: Until more information could be gleaned about Niv-Mizzet's intentions, Lazav took every opportunity to stall his experiments.

quotes.name: Swift Kick
quotes.flavor: Shintan sensed the malice in his opponent, but he did not strike until the orc's muscles tensed in preparation to throw the first punch.

quotes.name: Sunspear Shikari
quotes.flavor: Left without their leader Raksha, the leonin split into two prides: one side supported the regent kha, while the other rebelled in fury.

quotes.name: Hallowed Ground
quotes.flavor:
"On this site where Kjeld's blood was spilled, let none raise a fist or deny a beggar."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran priest

quotes.name: Karn's Bastion
quotes.flavor: Wakanda's towering ingenuity is manifest across Birnin Zana's skyline.

quotes.name: Giada, Font of Hope
quotes.flavor: "This city is my home. I will make it a place to be proud of."

quotes.name: Mindcrank
quotes.flavor:
"Let go of your memories and be reborn."
—Argent Etchings, plate 106, passage 27

quotes.name: Gaze of Granite
quotes.flavor: Golgari reclaimers resent the gorgons, begrudging the loss of so many fine nutrients locked away in stone.

quotes.name: Chromatic Lantern
quotes.flavor: By guild tradition, any puddle of multicolored light on the cobblestones can serve as neutral ground.

quotes.name: Noble Purpose
quotes.flavor: Fighting for the right reason is itself a source of strength.

quotes.name: Carnage Tyrant
quotes.flavor: But all he learned was the deaths of kings, . . .

quotes.name: Holy Day
quotes.flavor:
"Hoy hay fiesta y paz en nuestra tierra, pero la guerra no terminó. Guarda tu sed de sangre. La necesitarás mañana."
—Karrim, sanador samita

quotes.name: Skarrg, the Rage Pits
quotes.flavor:
"This palace will be our fire-spit, and roasted prince our victory meal. Send in the torch-pigs!"
—Ghut Rak, Gruul guildmage

quotes.name: Shimmer Dragon
quotes.flavor: The indigo dragon gladly traded a bit of its hoard for everlasting moonlight.

quotes.name: Brainsurge
quotes.flavor: In the Cosmos, secrets swirl and spark like windborne embers, and only Alrund can capture them.

quotes.name: Dimir Signet
quotes.flavor: An emblem of a secret guild, the Dimir insignia is seen only by its own members—and the doomed.

quotes.name: Containment Priest
quotes.flavor: Some protection requires a bit of finesse.

quotes.name: Hamza, Guardian of Arashin
quotes.flavor: "I stand with every member of my clan, and they stand with me."

quotes.name: Cloak of Feathers
quotes.flavor: A thousand feathers from a thousand birds, sewn with magic and song.

quotes.name: Pyroblast
quotes.flavor:
"Just the thing for those pesky water mages."
—Jaya Ballard, Task Mage

quotes.name: Shimmer Myr
quotes.flavor: It evades Phyrexians by hiding in the spaces between seconds.

quotes.name: Famished Ghoul
quotes.flavor: Memories have distinct tastes. Its favorites are the sickly sweetness of lost love and the bitter smokiness of cruel murder.

quotes.name: Kranioceros
quotes.flavor:
"A surly beast, the kranioceros will raise its defenses at the smallest threat. Stay out of sight and downwind, or you'll disrupt its natural migrations."
—Ebrel, godtoucher mentor

quotes.name: Bog Imp
quotes.flavor: On guard for larger dangers, we underestimated the power and speed of the Imp's muck-crusted claws.

quotes.name: Reprieve
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: As Faramir and Éowyn stood so, their hands met and clasped, though they did not know it.

quotes.name: Avacynian Priest
quotes.flavor: Moorlanders speak in awe of the priests' talent for arriving just in time to drive off the wicked things that prowl the ravished parish.

quotes.name: Languish
quotes.flavor: Life is such a fragile thing.

quotes.name: Rafiq of the Many
quotes.flavor: Many sigils, one purpose.

quotes.name: Ethersworn Canonist
quotes.flavor: "The noble work of our order is to infuse all life on Esper with etherium. Our goal will be reached more rapidly if new life is . . . suppressed."

quotes.name: World Map
quotes.flavor: And so their quest began.

quotes.name: You, Magic Playtester
quotes.flavor: Prize Card for the Unknown events at MagicCon Las Vegas, September 23-24, 2023.

quotes.name: Will-o'-the-Wisp
quotes.flavor: "About, about in reel and rout The death-fires danced at night; The water, like a witch's oils, Burnt green, and blue and white." —Samuel Coleridge, "The Rime of the Ancient Mariner"

quotes.name: Ambitious Farmhand // Seasoned Cathar
quotes.flavor: "The cathars have taught me many things, but I will never forget the hard, honest work that first callused my hands."

quotes.name: Executioner's Capsule
quotes.flavor: There is always a moment of trepidation before opening a message capsule, for fear of the judgment that might be contained within.

quotes.name: Rabbit Response
quotes.flavor: You never fight just one rabbitfolk. They bring the strength of their burrow to battle with them.

quotes.name: Sigardian Savior
quotes.flavor: "Begone, moon-cursed! These folk are no prey of yours."

quotes.name: Mossfire Valley
quotes.flavor:
"I come from a place far to the northwest. It's called The Pitt. It's ... well ... let's be honest ... a nightmare."
—Wernher

quotes.name: Ashen Rider
quotes.flavor: One offering to appease her on her arrival. Another to celebrate her departure.

quotes.name: Chromatic Lantern
quotes.flavor: By guild tradition, any puddle of multicolored light on the cobblestones can serve as neutral ground.

quotes.name: Demanding Dragon
quotes.flavor: A knight's devotion to their steed goes only so far.

quotes.name: Soulcage Fiend
quotes.flavor: Vowing to free the souls of her children, Kastinne followed the tormentors into the ghastly network of caves below Stensia.

quotes.name: Act on Impulse
quotes.flavor: "You don't want to know what happens after I put on the goggles."

quotes.name: Beacon of Creation
quotes.flavor: A chorus of life heralds the arrival of Mirrodin's final sun.

quotes.name: Benalish Knight
quotes.flavor:
"We called them 'armored lightning.'"
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

quotes.name: Imperious Perfect
quotes.flavor: In a culture of beauty, the most beautiful are worshipped as gods.

quotes.name: Kessig Wolf Run
quotes.flavor: When a werewolf changes for the first time, that first howl is said to echo through the wilds till moonset.

quotes.name: Arcane Teachings
quotes.flavor: Dwarves may teach at the speed of stone, but their results are solid.

quotes.name: Chapel Geist
quotes.flavor: Death has bound it with chains of past regrets. Forever it searches for atonement, each kindness removing a single link.

quotes.name: Eyes Everywhere
quotes.flavor: "They've got eyes inside my head!"

quotes.name: Old Hob, Alleycat Blues
quotes.flavor: "This is us against them, plain and simple. Either you're with us, or . . ."

quotes.name: Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite
quotes.flavor: "The Gitaxians whisper among themselves of other worlds. If they exist, we must bring Phyrexia's magnificence to them."

quotes.name: Dromoka's Gift
quotes.flavor: The simplest gift from a dragon can be a revered accolade for a human warrior.

quotes.name: Defense of the Heart
quotes.flavor:
"And as the rose began to bloom, the curse of Redtooth Keep began, at last, to wither."
—*Curse of the Werefox*

quotes.name: Caves of Koilos
quotes.flavor: After years of silence, the caves once again echo with the grisly sounds of Phyrexians preparing for war.

quotes.name: Shipwreck Marsh
quotes.flavor:
"There's one survivor. There's a thing in the belly of that ship that can't ever die."
—River Song

quotes.name: Isolated Chapel
quotes.flavor: Not every church is a place of faith.

quotes.name: Lifecrafter's Bestiary
quotes.flavor:
"Inspiration is found by looking outward."
—Oviya Pashiri, sage lifecrafter

quotes.name: Rain of Thorns
quotes.flavor: When the forests became havens for evil, the archmages devised new ways to cleanse the wilds.

quotes.name: Katara, the Fearless
quotes.flavor: "I will never, ever turn my back on people who need me!"

quotes.name: Floral Evoker
quotes.flavor: "Death is a natural thing. It replenishes the land's energy and nourishes the growth of all life."

quotes.name: Despoiler of Souls
quotes.flavor: Rats and vultures devour. It desecrates.

quotes.name: Goblin Balloon Brigade
quotes.flavor:
"From up here we can drop rocks and arrows and more rocks!"
"Uh, yeah boss, but how do we get down?"

quotes.name: Trygon Predator
quotes.flavor: Held aloft by metabolized magic, trygons are ravenous for sources of mystic fuel.

quotes.name: Shimmer of Possibility
quotes.flavor:
"There's something peculiar about the rain today."
—Janoc, Tin Street tinker

quotes.name: Eel-Hounds
quotes.flavor:
"Nothing runs faster over land or swims quicker than a giant eel-hound."
—Master Piandao

quotes.name: Arbiter of Knollridge
quotes.flavor: Though giants are mortal, they live so long and on such a grand scale that many small folk don't believe they ever truly die.

quotes.name: Woodland Druid
quotes.flavor: What is a tree? Slow hard thought. What is a flower? Swift soft flesh. What is a druid? Both.

quotes.name: Golgari Germination
quotes.flavor: The Golgari don't bury their dead. They plant them.

quotes.name: Rubinia Soulsinger
quotes.flavor: "Take up the quill, and feel your future flow into the runes."

quotes.name: Channel
quotes.flavor:
"As long as you are breathing, you always have something more to give."
—Valentin, Witherbloom dean

quotes.name: Putrefaction
quotes.flavor:
"Do you want to be alive or whole?"
—Ta-Karnst, Cho-Arrim healer

quotes.name: Shamanic Revelation
quotes.flavor: First, whispers of ancient days. Then, visions of things to come.

quotes.name: Enthralling Victor
quotes.flavor: If you stare at the sun for too long, you'll lose your ability to see clearly.

quotes.name: Titanic Growth
quotes.flavor: The massive dominate through might. The tiny survive with guile. Beware the tiny who become massive.

quotes.name: Manta Riders
quotes.flavor:
"Water is firmament to the finned."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

quotes.name: Blossoming Calm
quotes.flavor: Mood: A spell that protects her from her enemies.

quotes.name: Karplusan Forest
quotes.flavor: Between jagged, snowcapped peaks, the dense bands of hardy evergreens provide the perfect cover for roving bands of orc and goblin raiders.

quotes.name: Atlantean Cavalry
quotes.flavor:
"These surface dwellers feel safe with their feet on dry land. Let us remind them why they fear the deep water."
—Namor the Sub-Mariner

quotes.name: Builder's Blessing
quotes.flavor:
"Mix the mortar with holy wards, or blood will run in the streets."
—Vadvar, Thraben stonewright

quotes.name: Lord of the Pit
quotes.flavor: No sacrifice could quell its hunger, as darkness devoured all in its wake.

quotes.name: Warlord's Elite
quotes.flavor: "The Warlord thinks we've gone soft, does he? The Fist of Progress will prove him wrong!"

quotes.name: Willow Geist
quotes.flavor: Die beneath a tree, wake up a part of it.

quotes.name: Wall of Stone
quotes.flavor: The Earth herself lends her strength to these walls of living stone, which possess the stability of ancient mountains. These mighty bulwarks thwart ground-based troops, providing welcome relief for weary warriors who defend the land.

quotes.name: Spellseeker
quotes.flavor: Not content with mere answers, she hunts for the truth.

quotes.name: Honor Guard
quotes.flavor:
"It is not a choice I make, to have this guard. It is the choice of my people, and my duty to them."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

quotes.name: Ghostly Flicker
quotes.flavor: Sometimes it's useful to take a break from existence.

quotes.name: Concentrate
quotes.flavor: "The treasure in my mind is greater than any worldly glory."

quotes.name: Nova Flame
quotes.flavor: The Human Torch channels every iota of his power into a single burst—a burst that rivals the energies of an exploding star!

quotes.name: Heavenly Qilin
quotes.flavor: It strides through the universe as though stepping on the stars, crossing freely between the celestial and earthly worlds.

quotes.name: Shu Elite Companions
quotes.flavor: Throughout the three kingdoms, important generals were often guarded by small groups of expert soldiers known as "elite companions."

quotes.name: Ticket Turbotubes
quotes.flavor: "WE ARE FILLED WITH TICKETS. WE ARE FILLED WITH PURPOSE."

quotes.name: Invasion Tactics
quotes.flavor:
"Your moment of truth isn't gonna be in front of some map. It's gonna to be out there on the battlefield."
—Aang

quotes.name: Vindictive Flamestoker
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Promos
quotes.flavor: Her faith burns hot enough to sear away the flesh of the heretic.

quotes.name: Mutavault
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: Some worlds possess a hidden core where life's essence constantly surges.

quotes.name: Foot Soldiers
quotes.flavor: Infantry deployment is the art of putting your troops in the wrong place at the right time.

quotes.name: Containment Protocol
quotes.flavor: "What else can we do? No prison could hold Tokka, and she'll hurt someone if we let her out to play."

quotes.name: Pest Mascot
quotes.flavor: Hungering for the zest of life.

quotes.name: Reconnaissance Mission
quotes.flavor:
"The bonders work with creatures that fly, slink, and burrow. Assume they know everything."
—Jirina Kudro

quotes.name: Alhammarret's Archive
quotes.flavor: It contains the totality of Alhammarret's notes, theories, and ponderings.

quotes.name: City on Fire
quotes.flavor: "Avernus was never my home . . . ."

quotes.name: Dauthi Jackal
quotes.flavor:
"All Dauthi are jackals, regardless of breed."
—Lyna, Soltari emissary

quotes.name: Ghostly Prison
quotes.flavor: Though the spirits' bodies were ethereal, Agnur soon learned that their blades were quite solid—and razor-sharp.

quotes.name: Choose Your Champion
quotes.flavor: "I am nothing if not fair. I've chosen my champion. Now you must choose yours."

quotes.name: Jackal Pup
quotes.flavor:
"Cry havoc and let slip the dogs of war."
—William Shakespeare, *Julius Caesar*

quotes.name: Relentless Assault
quotes.flavor:
"Flog and Squee / Up the tree / See the army / Flee, flee, flee."
—Goblin nursery rhyme/war cry

quotes.name: Elda, Conjurer of Spectacle
quotes.flavor: "Definitely try this at home, kids!"

quotes.name: Opt
quotes.flavor: "It's easy to anticipate Captain Storm's orders: take the more dangerous route."

quotes.name: Relentless Raptor
quotes.flavor: As the battle for Orazca unfolded, the contenders discovered that others had already staked a claim.

quotes.name: Mind Sculpt
quotes.flavor:
"Your mind was a curious mix of madness and genius. I just took away the genius."
—Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Goblin Brigand
quotes.flavor: Like a loaded cannon—point and shoot.

quotes.name: Wish
quotes.set_name: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms Promos
quotes.flavor:
"If you had just one wish, what would it be? Gold, or angel song? Finding a lost love, or finding your way back home? Let me sing a song about one wish that came true . . ."
—Ellywick Tumblestrum

quotes.name: Tamiyo's Journal
quotes.flavor: Entry 855: There's more to Avacyn's madness . . .

quotes.name: Saltblast
quotes.flavor: Dominaria erodes with each passing gust.

quotes.name: Wild Defiance
quotes.flavor:
"When civilization reaches out its greedy hand, take it off at the wrist."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

quotes.name: Gerrard, Weatherlight Hero
quotes.flavor: Gerrard's final act ensured his legacy would never die.

quotes.name: Avenging Hunter
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: "I will remember my friends. But you? You won't be remembered at all."

quotes.name: Hardened Scales
quotes.flavor:
"They're herbivores, not prey animals. Go startle one if you want to know the difference."
—Huatli

quotes.name: Gutter Skulker // Gutter Shortcut
quotes.flavor: Some people take that as inspiration.

quotes.name: Price of Progress
quotes.flavor: Man versus nature is not a fair fight.

quotes.name: Novice Inspector
quotes.flavor:
"If the perfect evidence appears at your feet, your first task is to rule out misdirection."
—The Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations handbook

quotes.name: Wellgabber Apothecary
quotes.flavor: "You've discovered that boggarts bite, I see. And will the militia be chasing this lot? . . . Ah, you're staying in town to avoid Nath's hunt. Wise. Now this poultice . . ."

quotes.name: Bribe Taker
quotes.flavor: In New Capenna, it's survival of the richest.

quotes.name: Disallow
quotes.flavor:
"How easily your flames are quenched."
—Baral, Chief of Compliance

quotes.name: Holy Day
quotes.flavor:
"The day of Spirits; my soul's calm retreat / Which none disturb!"
—Henry Vaughan, "The Night"

quotes.name: Lorescale Coatl
quotes.flavor:
"The enlightenment I never found in etherium I have found traced in the coatl's scales."
—Ranalus, vedalken heretic

quotes.name: Return of the Wildspeaker
quotes.flavor: "The curse is broken."

quotes.name: Shinka, the Bloodsoaked Keep
quotes.flavor: The glow from within looks inviting, but woe awaits whomever finds out who stokes the fire or what simmers in the pot.

quotes.name: Nephalia Smuggler
quotes.flavor: "My drivers are trustworthy. I removed their tongues myself. Any other questions?"

quotes.name: Curiosity
quotes.flavor: "Surely you know the joy of the hunt, my furry friend. My kind of hunt just takes a different form than yours."

quotes.name: Skyknight Legionnaire
quotes.flavor: Squadrons of skyknights are available for deployment around the clock, capable of reaching any district in the city within minutes.

quotes.name: Drakuseth, Maw of Flames
quotes.flavor:
"Spread out, you idiots! Spread out!"
—Marsden, party leader, last words

quotes.name: Synapse Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"Species XR17 feeds upon the mental energies of its victims. This explains why the goblins remain unaffected."
—Riptide Project researcher

quotes.name: Aladdin's Ring
quotes.flavor: Some say Aladdin's third wish was for this ring.

quotes.name: Hydroblast
quotes.flavor:
"Heed the lessons of our time: the forms of water may move the land itself and hold captive the fires within."
—Gustha Ebbasdotter, Kjeldoran Royal Mage

quotes.name: Masterwork of Ingenuity
quotes.flavor:
"The crucible yields what you have forged in your mind. You need only reach in and draw the masterwork forth."
—Wahara, Keeper of the Crucible

quotes.name: Carrier Pigeons
quotes.flavor:
"Birds know no borders! Why, then, should we?"
—General Varchild, in a missive to King Darien of Kjeldor

quotes.name: Nesting Grounds
quotes.flavor: A butterfly will lead the way to secret things.

quotes.name: Defenestrated Phantom
quotes.flavor:
"Never parley near high windows."
—Teysa

quotes.name: Stormbeacon Blade
quotes.flavor: "Sky and Ember, guide my blade!"

quotes.name: Mind Rot
quotes.flavor:
"It saddens me to lose a source of inspiration. This one seemed especially promising."
—Ashiok

quotes.name: Mirran Safehouse
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Promos
quotes.flavor:
"Melira helped me design it. Those who are infected by the oil cannot cross the threshold. We should be safe inside."
—Koth

quotes.name: Army of the Damned
quotes.flavor: Sometimes death comes knocking. Sometimes it tears down the walls.

quotes.name: Ridgeline Rager
quotes.flavor: While armies battled across Jamuraa, beasts stalked the high places looking for victims.

quotes.name: Hunting Triad
quotes.flavor: "Eyeblights are easy to track. Just follow the imperfections."

quotes.name: Ancient Amphitheater
quotes.flavor: The arbiter Galanda Feudkiller judges Lorwyn's squabbles from a lofty perspective.

quotes.name: Sure Strike
quotes.flavor: "Everyone has a weak spot."

quotes.name: Continue?
quotes.flavor: "You've gotta give it your all because anything less won't get the job done."

quotes.name: Sky Swallower
quotes.flavor: Would you trade the world for such a pet?

quotes.name: Battle Squadron
quotes.flavor: The goblins made an unruly pile with military precision.

quotes.name: Scour from Existence
quotes.flavor:
"Our people and our very lands disappear as if they never were. We no longer fight for glory, or honor. We battle now for the right to exist."
—General Tazri, allied commander

quotes.name: Narset's Reversal
quotes.flavor:
"In the disarray of battle, an enemy's attack may be your most convenient weapon."
—Narset

quotes.name: Village Rites
quotes.flavor:
「同僚たちは血の時代の野蛮さを避難しているが、俺は無限に続く戦争の魔法から学べることは多いと思っている。」
——シルバークイルの学部長、エムブローズ

quotes.name: Sagu Mauler
quotes.flavor: The Sagu Jungle's thick undergrowth conceals even the largest predators—if they wish to remain hidden.

quotes.name: Naturalize
quotes.flavor: The remains of ancient civilizations litter the run-down land.

quotes.name: Sangrite Backlash
quotes.flavor:
"Sangrite is the dragon's beating heart. Little wonder, then, that so many fools' chests burst trying to contain it."
—Sarkhan Vol

quotes.name: Nyxbloom Ancient
quotes.flavor: Ancient yet ever-young, it is wise and subtle—and cruel and reckless as the spring itself.

quotes.name: Western Paladin
quotes.flavor:
"Expect nothing but scorn, flattery, and lies. And never turn your back on him."
—The Northern Paladin

quotes.name: Avatar of Discord
quotes.flavor: Such is the power of Rakdos that even his shadow takes on a cruel life of its own.

quotes.name: Shu Foot Soldiers
quotes.flavor: Liu Bei lost many men at the battle of Runan because of his lack of strategy. It wasn't until he met Kongming that he began to truly succeed as a leader.

quotes.name: Gruul Guildgate
quotes.flavor:
"Old turf. Powerful turf. Much good blood spilled here."
—Ruric Thar

quotes.name: Stalwart Valkyrie
quotes.flavor: "Only the worthy may pass."

quotes.name: Pyromancer's Goggles
quotes.flavor:
"I hope to meet Jaya Ballard someday. I think we'd get along."
—Chandra Nalaar

quotes.name: Thorn of the Black Rose
quotes.flavor: If bribery and intimidation fail, Marchesa turns to her favorite form of persuasion.

quotes.name: Overwhelming Intellect
quotes.flavor: "My brain hurts."

quotes.name: Hand of Silumgar
quotes.flavor: Silumgar trains those whom he favors in his magic, granting them the ability to spread his disdain across the land.

quotes.name: Griptide
quotes.flavor:
"Beware the seagrafs just off the shore. These waters are filled with hungry geists looking for an easy meal."
—Captain Eberhart

quotes.name: Hover Barrier
quotes.flavor: As whispers and rumors increased, so did the demand for fail-safe barriers.

quotes.name: Urza, Prince of Kroog
quotes.flavor: The prince consort was happy to let Yotia's coffers fund his extravagant research.

quotes.name: Guard Gomazoa
quotes.flavor: It lingers near the outposts of the Makindi Trenches, inadvertently granting another layer of defense.

quotes.name: Black Tom Cassidy
quotes.flavor: "I talk to the dirt and the dirt talks back. And you listen to Black Tom—the dirt knows everything."

quotes.name: Demolish
quotes.flavor:
"Pound the steel until it fits. Doesn't work? Bash to bits."
—Dwarven forging song

quotes.name: Kodama's Reach
quotes.flavor:
"The land grows only where the kami will it."
—Dosan the Falling Leaf

quotes.name: Curse of the Swine
quotes.flavor: Another imminent battle subsided in busy snuffling and carefree rooting.

quotes.name: Marwyn, the Clearcutter
quotes.flavor: "Llanowar is both a forest and a people. Forests are replaceable. People are not."

quotes.name: Thornhide Wolves
quotes.flavor:
"Halana grew brambles to create a barricade around our camp, hoping that it would keep the wolves out. That was a mistake for which we almost paid dearly."
—Alena, trapper of Kessig

quotes.name: Unholy Strength
quotes.flavor: Such power grows the body as it shrinks the soul.

quotes.name: Goblin Smuggler
quotes.flavor: "No one here but us empty barrels!"

quotes.name: Snake Basket
quotes.flavor:
"Uh, does anyone have a flute?"
—Rana, Suq'Ata market fool

quotes.name: Yavimaya Ancients
quotes.flavor:
"The Ancients teach us that if we can but last, we shall prevail."
—Kaysa, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

quotes.name: Solstice Zealot
quotes.flavor: "Embrace the light, or succumb to the shadows."

quotes.name: Brightglass Gearhulk
quotes.flavor: "A new day dawns for Avishkar, and we shall draw our power from its light."

quotes.name: Zephyr Falcon
quotes.flavor: Although greatly prized among falconers, the Zephyr Falcon is capricious and not easily tamed.

quotes.name: Reclamation Sage
quotes.flavor: "What was once formed by masons, shaped by smiths, or given life by mages, I will return to the embrace of the earth."

quotes.name: Hardened Escort
quotes.flavor: "It's not magic. I read the writing on the House's walls. I listen to its sighs. I smell the changes in its air. It tells me where danger lies."

quotes.name: Wakestone Gargoyle
quotes.flavor: Its pulsating cry shatters bonds of iron, granite, and servitude.

quotes.name: Perplexing Test
quotes.flavor: "Your proofs were a bit nontraditional, but effective nonetheless. Full marks."

quotes.name: Terramorphic Expanse
quotes.flavor: Take two steps north into the unsettled future, south into the unquiet past, east into the present day, or west into the great unknown.

quotes.name: Quarrel's End
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"It is a joy to us to see you return into your own."
—Éomer

quotes.name: Rivendell
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"Were I to go where my heart dwells, I would now be wandering in the fair valley of Rivendell."
—Aragorn

quotes.name: Haunted Fengraf
quotes.flavor: A ghoulcaller's playground.

quotes.name: Mana Drain
quotes.flavor: Enthusiasm is no match for preparation.

quotes.name: Glory Seeker
quotes.flavor: "There's no contract to sign, no oath to swear. The enlistment procedure is to unsheathe your sword and point it at the enemy."

quotes.name: Nobody
quotes.flavor: "I don't need a name. I'm nobody."

quotes.name: Wirewood Herald
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Elves vs. Goblins
quotes.flavor: The goblins laughed as the elf ran away, until more came back.

quotes.name: Mind Flayer
quotes.set_name: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms Promos
quotes.flavor: "Shed your thoughts and let my will flow through you."

quotes.name: Taurean Mauler
quotes.flavor: The power of a waterfall. The fury of an avalanche. The intellect of a gale-force wind.

quotes.name: Fallen Ideal
quotes.flavor: "Victory is nonnegotiable."

quotes.name: Earth Elemental
quotes.flavor: Los elementales de tierra tienen la fortaleza eterna de la piedra y la resistencia de las montañas. En contacto primordial con la tierra que habitan, contemplan las cosas a largo plazo y desprecian la prisa impetuosa de las criaturas mortales de vida efímera.

quotes.name: Thought Vessel
quotes.flavor: A window into the mind of someone you once knew.

quotes.name: Dissipate
quotes.flavor:
"If you weren't born with it, you don't need it."
—Grahilah, former trader of Amiqat

quotes.name: Galvanize
quotes.flavor: "Why doesn't Kylox put an off switch on these things?!"

quotes.name: Tegan Jovanka
quotes.flavor: "You certainly know how to fly this crate, don't you?"

quotes.name: Lightning Elemental
quotes.flavor:
"Un destello del relámpago, un rompimiento de la ola,
Él pasa de la vida a descansar en la tumba."
William Knox, "Mortalidad"

quotes.name: Reverse Engineer
quotes.flavor: The Hold, an illegal research facility in a derelict merchant ship, became a wellspring of renegade intelligence.

quotes.name: Basandra, Battle Seraph
quotes.flavor: "Why listen to the mumblings of wizards when the lash speaks true?"

quotes.name: Labyrinth Minotaur
quotes.flavor:
"I doubt any labyrinth minotaurs still live—but then we minotaurs are stubborn beings."
—Onatah, Anaba shaman

quotes.name: Maximus, Knight Apparent
quotes.flavor: "It is a knight's duty to better this fallen world."

quotes.name: Keeper of Fables
quotes.flavor:
"Only the lion knows more stories than I do."
—Chulane, Teller of Tales

quotes.name: Abstract Paintmage
quotes.flavor: "Life is vivid; the pigments I use should be too."

quotes.name: Time Warp
quotes.flavor:
"Let's do it again!"
—Squee, goblin cabin hand

quotes.name: Font of Ire
quotes.flavor: Drink deep, and find your vengeance fulfilled.

quotes.name: Doctor Doom, Unrivaled
quotes.flavor: "Those who dare stand against Doom do not stand for long!"

quotes.name: Painiac
quotes.flavor: "You're about to be struck by a brilliant idea!"

quotes.name: Jadelight Spelunker
quotes.flavor: The River Heralds found clues to a grand heritage below Ixalan's surface.

quotes.name: Rubinia Soulsinger
quotes.flavor: "Take up the quill, and feel your future flow into the runes."

quotes.name: Seedtime
quotes.flavor:
The hippo grows wings to fight the condor.
—Nantuko teaching

quotes.name: Amazing Spider-Girl
quotes.flavor:
"I've got to do this Spider-thing no matter what pain or misery awaits me—this is a Spider-Girl World!"
—Spider-Girl, Mayday Parker

quotes.name: Agent Phil Coulson
quotes.flavor: "The big guns are in flight. Agent 13, what's your status?"

quotes.name: Master Biomancer
quotes.flavor: "Nature is a wonderful engineer but works far too slowly for my tastes."

quotes.name: This Is How It Ends
quotes.flavor: "There's a gravestone here for someone with the same name as me."

quotes.name: Flamekin Brawler
quotes.flavor: When he hits people, they stay hit.

quotes.name: Luminesce
quotes.flavor:
"The White Shield is not the burnished metal you lash to your forearm but the conviction that burns in your chest."
—Lucilde Fiksdotter, leader of the Order of the White Shield

quotes.name: Cathartic Reunion
quotes.flavor: To be together again—that is the greatest gift of all.

quotes.name: Bear Umbra
quotes.flavor: "Flee! Or face the wrath of mama bear!"

quotes.name: Chance Encounter
quotes.flavor:
"What are the odds, indeed?"
—Yusri, to Desera

quotes.name: Forced Fruition
quotes.flavor:
"Petals within petals within petals, tadpole. The truth lurks below an opulence of illusion."
—Neerdiv, fallowsage

quotes.name: Wirefly Hive
quotes.flavor:
"The lifespan of a wirefly can be precisely described as 'short.'"
—Bruenna, Neurok leader

quotes.name: Chandra Nalaar // Chandra Nalaar
quotes.flavor: All-Star Planeswalker

quotes.name: Duress
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Divine vs. Demonic
quotes.flavor:
"Don't worry. I'm not going to deprive you of all your secrets. Just your most precious one."
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Disdainful Stroke
quotes.flavor: In retrospect, using storm magic against a storm giant was not the wisest strategy.

quotes.name: Huddle Up
quotes.flavor: "Are you sure this is going to work?" asked Will. "No," said Rowan. "But if it does, it's going to be spectacular."

quotes.name: Dromoka, the Eternal
quotes.flavor:
"The bane of countless shattered weapons, each a failure to slay her."
—Daghatar the Adamant

quotes.name: Hinterland Harbor
quotes.flavor: Radioactive fog was the least of the inhabitants' worries.

quotes.name: Lavinia, Azorius Renegade
quotes.flavor: "I told Jace that Ravnica would fall apart if he didn't take his responsibilities seriously. I didn't want to be right."

quotes.name: Trailblazer's Boots
quotes.flavor: It's much easier to list the places they *haven't* been.

quotes.name: Mana Leak
quotes.flavor: The fatal flaw in every plan is the assumption that you know more than your enemy.

quotes.name: Telepathy
quotes.flavor:
"The most disappointing thing about learning telepathy is finding out how boring people really are."
—Teferi, fourth-level student

quotes.name: Sabertooth Wyvern
quotes.flavor: Most creatures grow out of their baby teeth, but sabertooth wyverns grow into theirs.

quotes.name: Cathar Commando
quotes.flavor: "Honorable tactics are for honorable foes. These werewolves are preying on innocent travelers. I'll stab them in the back while they sleep if I have to."

quotes.name: Mind Rot
quotes.flavor:
"The beauty of mental attacks is that your victims never remember them."
—Volrath

quotes.name: Shambling Goblin
quotes.flavor:
"The Kolaghan send them at us. We kill and raise them. They fight the next wave the Kolaghan send. It's a neat little cycle."
—Asmala, Silumgar sorcerer

quotes.name: Krosan Grip
quotes.flavor:
"Give up these unnatural weapons, these scrolls. Heart and mind and fist are enough."
—Zyd, Kamahlite druid

quotes.name: Darksteel Angel
quotes.flavor: An alloy of curiosity and hope; the caretaker of a gleaming plane of possibility.

quotes.name: Art Appreciation
quotes.flavor: There's no defending against public opinion.

quotes.name: Honden of Infinite Rage
quotes.flavor: To the sorrow of all, its rage became focused on those who once stoked it.

quotes.name: Animation Module
quotes.flavor: Design leads to progress.

quotes.name: Aegis Turtle
quotes.flavor:
"The endurance of the ancient turtles in a land so harsh makes a strong case for patience, tranquility, and composure."
—Gavi, nest warden

quotes.name: Pull from Tomorrow
quotes.flavor:
"I do things in my own time."
—Etha, initiate of Rhet crop

quotes.name: Primitive Etchings
quotes.flavor: Ancient carvings in the trees of Krosa glow with power once again.

quotes.name: Tidal Kraken
quotes.flavor: To merfolk, pirates are a nuisance. To pirates, merfolk are a threat. To the kraken, they're both appetizers.

quotes.name: Skaab Goliath
quotes.flavor: Three heads are better than one.

quotes.name: Learn from the Past
quotes.flavor:
"The Great Ring shall go now to be an heirloom of the North Kingdom; but records of it shall be left in Gondor, lest a time come when the memory of these great matters shall grow dim."
—*Scroll of Isildur*

quotes.name: Shinka, the Bloodsoaked Keep
quotes.flavor: The keep was called the Hornburg, for a trumpet sounded upon the tower echoed in the Deep behind, as if armies long-forgotten were issuing to war from caves beneath the hills.

quotes.name: Intangible Virtue
quotes.flavor:
"A real soldier's bravery comes from within ... from his heart and his soul."
—Elder Arthur Maxson

quotes.name: Eidolon of the Great Revel
quotes.flavor: Xenagos reveled while Theros burned.

quotes.name: Great Sable Stag
quotes.flavor: Ineffable and incorruptible.

quotes.name: Puppeteer
quotes.flavor:
"That's the funny thing about free will. You don't feel any different without it."
—Ambassador Laquatus

quotes.name: Lionheart Glimmer
quotes.flavor: The survivors would no longer be picked off one by one. It was their turn to hunt.

quotes.name: Seething Song
quotes.flavor: Vulshok mana rituals echo the day when the red sun burst through Mirrodin's surface to take its place in the heavens.

quotes.name: Inexorable Tide
quotes.flavor: Radiation is an invisible tide that seeps into the bones of the land, changing it irrevocably.

quotes.name: Cloud Elemental
quotes.flavor: The soratami surround their sky-castles with living clouds that serve as both sword and shield.

quotes.name: Rumbleweed
quotes.flavor: It's a one-ecosystem army.

quotes.name: Seekers' Squire
quotes.flavor: Dusk follows the light.

quotes.name: Beloved Beggar // Generous Soul
quotes.flavor: As long as evil threatens his town, the Blessed Sleep can wait.

quotes.name: Spectral Hunt-Caller
quotes.flavor: The nightsong begins with a lone howl, but soon swells to a deafening chorus.

quotes.name: Hour of Reckoning
quotes.flavor: Those who are chosen do not doubt. Those who remain do not lament.

quotes.name: Wooded Foothills
quotes.flavor: Home and hunting ground for Kaldheim's fearsome trolls.

quotes.name: Flaxen Intruder // Welcome Home
quotes.flavor: The middle blade was just right.

quotes.name: Nearby Planet
quotes.flavor:
"Here's a nice place we haven't hit yet."
—Captain Rex Nebula

quotes.name: Wall of Bone
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Garruk vs. Liliana
quotes.flavor:
"Graveyards are sacrilege! A waste of perfectly good bones."
—Keren-Dur, necromancer lord

quotes.name: Worn Powerstone
quotes.flavor:
"The *palantíri* of the Kings of Old: the name meant 'that which looks far away.' The Orthanc-stone was one, and it is beyond Saruman's art."
—Gandalf

quotes.name: Sandblast
quotes.flavor: The sands of Amonkhet can be as much a boon as a bane. It depends entirely on which way the wind blows.

quotes.name: Basilisk Collar
quotes.flavor: A mark of companionship, not subservience.

quotes.name: Armadillo Cloak
quotes.flavor: "Don't laugh. It works."

quotes.name: Dragon Mage
quotes.flavor: "You'll bend to my will—with or without your precious sanity."

quotes.name: Mutilate
quotes.flavor: "You mortals turn to dust in the blink of an eye. I only expedite your fate."

quotes.name: Advantageous Proclamation
quotes.flavor: "The beneficent council deems you worthy of favor. They hope this doesn't provoke envy from your peers."

quotes.name: Alluring Scent
quotes.flavor: No earthly armor is protection against this sweetness.

quotes.name: Regal Bunnicorn
quotes.flavor:
"It's entirely peaceful, as long as you don't try to pet it, pen it, take its food, take its hide, sit on its grass, or dress it up in colorful garb for human holidays."
—Sturwynn, Boundary Lands ranger

quotes.name: Manifold Key
quotes.flavor:
"Locks want to be opened, and treasure wants to be free."
—Nayrex Slipfinger, master thief

quotes.name: Grizzly Bears
quotes.flavor: Don't try to outrun one of Dominaria's grizzlies; it'll catch you, knock you down, and eat you. Of course, you could run up a tree. In that case you'll get a nice view before it knocks the tree down and eats you.

quotes.name: Grievous Wound
quotes.flavor: Vicky was so tired. The pain began to fade. "You were so brave," said her grandmother's voice from somewhere far away. "But it's time to rest now."

quotes.name: Mesmeric Orb
quotes.flavor: The Cult of the Mothman guards these precious eggs, using them to create oils to anoint their effigies.

quotes.name: Amphin Pathmage
quotes.flavor:
"There are those who do not believe in the existence of the amphin. This seems somehow to be of their own design."
—Gor Muldrak, *Cryptohistories*

quotes.name: Blood Rites
quotes.flavor:
"The threat of the kami was made worse by the blood rituals of the ogres, who freed terrifying oni to wander Kamigawa unhindered."
—*Observations of the Kami War*

quotes.name: Masumaro, First to Live
quotes.flavor:
"In the waning moments of war, humanity's most ancient ancestors return. But whose side shall they make their own?"
—Isao, Enlightened Bushi

quotes.name: Steamcore Scholar
quotes.flavor: "Hm. That's weird."

quotes.name: Wayfarer's Bauble
quotes.flavor: It is the forest beyond the horizon, the mountain waiting to be climbed, the new land across the endless sea.

quotes.name: Bayou
quotes.flavor: 2021 Legacy Champion

quotes.name: Rishkar, Peema Renegade
quotes.flavor: "Aether is the soul of Kaladesh, and all souls should be free."

quotes.name: Malfunctioning Holodeck
quotes.flavor:
"The holodeck safeties are still engaged, right?"
—Ensign Kei

quotes.name: Drowned Catacomb
quotes.flavor:
"The living goddess Amdo sees and hears all."
—Ramo

quotes.name: Guttersnipe
quotes.flavor: He wants to watch Ravnica burn, one soul at a time.

quotes.name: Disowned Ancestor
quotes.flavor: Long after death, the spirits of the Disowned continue to seek redemption among their Abzan kin.

quotes.name: Pillage
quotes.flavor:
"Burn their homes. Salt their lands. Nothing survives."
—The Western Paladin

quotes.name: Implements of Sacrifice
quotes.flavor: Relics of the Order of the Ebon Hand, the bowl and dagger bespeak the hideous cruelty of its rituals.
